# CANDIDATE: VIX_INTRADAY_MEAN_REVERSION_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Intraday VIX spikes above its short-term EMA while SPY is above VWAP and RSI is elevated often precede a short-term pullback in SPY. This edge exists because elevated VIX reflects heightened fear/volatility, and when combined with overbought RSI and a bearish EMA ribbon, it signals exhaustion of short-term bullish momentum.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Enter short when all conditions are met on the same 5-minute bar:  
- VIX > 1.5 × EMA20(VIX)  
- SPY close > VWAP (intraday)  
- RSI(14) > 60  
- EMA8 < EMA21 (bearish ribbon alignment)  
**Exit:**  
- Primary stop: Chart-stop at the most recent swing high (prior to entry)  
- TP1: Exit 1/3 of position at VWAP (mean reversion target)  
- Runner: Trail remaining 2/3 at 6% below the high-water mark (closing price)  
**Regime filters:** Only consider trades when VIX is between 15 and 35, time between 10:30-12:00 ET, and avoid major news releases (FOMC, CPI, NFP, mega-cap earnings).
